name: Butterfly Rouge
source:
The protagonist has her dream job in the planning department of a candy company.
She fell in love with her boss and they started living together and planning to get married.
But, her private and work lives were starting to get incompatible...
translation:
主角在一家糖果公司的企划部拥有她梦想的工作。
她爱上了她的老板，他们开始同居并计划结婚。
但是，她的私人生活和工作生活开始变得不相容……
